_comment: Auto-pinhole (#173) for deconz:zigbee — the native deCONZ REST+websocket API consumed by Home Assistant's deconz integration. No MQTT. deconz and HA typically sit in different zones, so this is a CROSS-zone pinhole (allowed only if the consumer's zone is on the provider's pinhole-allowed-from list). HA uses explicit IP -> unicast, no multicast relay.
